sloka: यथाज्ञप्तं महाबाहो त्वया गुल्मनिवेशनम्।तत्तथा ऽनुष्ठितं वीर त्वद्वाक्यसमनन्तरम् ।। ६.८५.५ ।।
transliteration: yathājñaptaṁ mahābāho tvayā gulmaniveśanam।tattathā 'nuṣṭhitaṁ vīra tvadvākyasamanantaram ।। 6.85.5 ।।

translations.english: " After your command the army has been divided and placed at respective places as you said."
